$schema_version_note: Hivemind capability tiers. Zero external dependencies; consumed by scripts/hive/model-tier.mjs.

openai/gpt-6.1-sol.notes: Frontier reasoning orchestrator with the strongest spec-compilation and contract-review accuracy; used as the default architect and auditor baseline.

openai/gpt-6-astra.notes: Apex escalation model reserved for algorithmic and concurrency deadlocks that survived two implementation attempts.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.notes: Frontier long-context architecture model; strongest at whole-repository contract design and multi-file refactor planning.

anthropic/claude-fable-5-2.notes: Frontier reasoning specialist used as an alternate oracle when a second opinion on design soundness is required.

google/gemini-4-argon.notes: Frontier model with a very large native context window; reads core files directly and authors contracts without micro-scouting.

google/gemini-4-carbon.notes: Frontier macro-context lead variant tuned for long-horizon orchestration and wide fan-out planning.

openai/gpt-5.1-codex-max.notes: Highest-capability Codex reasoning tier; deep code-trace analysis for architecture and escalation reviews.

openai/gpt-5.2-codex.notes: Frontier Codex generation with strong repository-scale reasoning and precise patch synthesis.

openai/gpt-5.2.notes: Frontier general-reasoning model available through OAuth; used for architecture when Codex variants are unavailable.

anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5.notes: Smart workhorse: near-frontier multi-file implementation quality at a fraction of the cost; valid as a top-of-range builder.

deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Reasoning-escalated DeepSeek tier for contract-heavy implementation slices that exceed flash reliability.

opencode/deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Same reasoning-escalated DeepSeek tier routed through the OpenCode Go subscription; identical capability class.

openai/gpt-5.1-codex.notes: Strong code-generation tier below Codex Max; reliable for bounded multi-file implementation work.

openai/gpt-5.1.notes: General smart tier with solid review and refactor judgement; below the frontier orchestrators.

deepseek/deepseek-chat.notes: Standard non-reasoning chat tier; adequate for mechanical edits, renames, and routine test wiring.

openai/gpt-5.1-codex-mini.notes: Standard lightweight Codex tier for narrow, well-specified single-file changes.

opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash.notes: High-throughput cheap worker used for scouts, verifiers, and most parallel builder slices; never an architect or oracle.

deepseek/deepseek-flash.notes: Direct-API cheap worker for recon and mechanical implementation; lowest cost per completed slice.

opencode/glm-5.3-flash.notes: Cheap high-volume worker from the OpenCode Go pool; best for wide parallel builder fan-out.

anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5.notes: Cheap fast Anthropic tier for recon, log compression, and read-only verification.

openai/gpt-6-luna.notes: Cheapest GPT-6 generation tier; high-throughput small-diff worker and locator.
